_comment: AWS-native equivalent of the discovery tool's nested vCenter JSON. Describes the environment the two discovered servers live in: network, routing, the security-group chain, load-balancing, and compute grouping. Sourced from ec2/elbv2/autoscaling/rds/elasticache describe-* on 2026-08-27T22:37Z under profile personal-transform.

environment.tag_gap: provider default_tags do NOT propagate to ASG-launched EC2 instances or their EBS volumes - those carry only Name. ~$50/mo of EC2+EBS spend is invisible to cost-allocation-tag reports.

network.single_az_note: Both EC2 instances, the single NAT gateway, the RDS instance, and the memcached node are all in us-east-1a. The 1b subnets exist for RDS/ElastiCache subnet-group requirements and ALB/NLB AZ spread only. An us-east-1a failure is a full outage.

routing.private_rt: 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-0732400cd89878961 (shared by all private subnets - single NAT)

ingress: TCP 9000 from fbctf-demo-web-nginx (inert - NLB does not preserve client SG)
TCP 9000 from 10.20.10.0/24 + 10.20.11.0/24 (NLB ENIs - this is the effective rule)

compute_groups.name: fbctf-demo-web
compute_groups.role: nginx 1.10.3 reverse proxy; terminates ALB HTTP, forwards FastCGI to the NLB
compute_groups.provisioning: boot-time from S3 prebuilt tarball + app provision.sh; ~5 min to healthy

compute_groups.name: fbctf-demo-app
compute_groups.role: HHVM 3.21.11 FastCGI app server on :9000; runs fbctf (Hack/PHP)
compute_groups.provisioning: boot-time from S3 prebuilt tarball + provision.sh + guarded one-shot DB bootstrap (schema import, app user, admin row); ~4 min to NLB-healthy

traffic_path: internet -> ALB(:80 HTTP) -> web/nginx(:80) -> NLB(:9000 TCP) -> app/HHVM(:9000 FastCGI) -> {RDS MySQL :3306, ElastiCache memcached :11211}

recovery_characteristics.instance_replacement: ASG relaunch + ~4-5 min boot-time provisioning (depends on S3 + dl.hhvm.com / NodeSource / npm reachability; S3-vendored fallbacks exist)
recovery_characteristics.az_failure: full outage (all stateful + compute in us-east-1a)
recovery_characteristics.rds: no automated backups (retention 0), no deletion protection, single-AZ - no recovery path
recovery_characteristics.data_loss_on_destroy: terraform destroy removes RDS with skip_final_snapshot=true; scoreboard data is not preserved
